correctness.rationale: The homogeneous mean-hazard substitution gives F(x)=(1-mu)x+(1-x)(1-exp[-mu*x-B*x²-C*x³]) and interval invariance. Equilibria require 0<x<1/(1+mu) and C=T_B(x) where L(x)=log((1-x)/(1-(1+mu)x)) has strictly positive coefficients ((1+mu)^k-1)/k. Thus T_B=(B2-B)/x+C3+sum_{k>=4}L_k x^{k-3}; for B<B2 it is coercive/strictly convex, for B=B2 strictly increasing, and for B>B2 strictly increasing from -infinity, giving the six count regimes. F'(x)>-mu>-1; the sign of F-x and T_B' gives all local multipliers. With no positive root, orbit monotone decreases to zero; reciprocal-power telescoping for F(x)=x-a x^{r+1}+... yields each three sharp extinction rates. Independent exact rational expansion for mu=2/5 confirmed coefficients B2, C3, D4; the source verifier includes finite motif/root scans, not used as proof of all x and all hypergraphs.

originality.rationale: The motivating Liu-Schaposnik HyCo-SIS work defines overlap-reinforced discrete SIS and notes only linear pairwise stability at the disease-free state in the single-pathogen mean-hazard closure. The materially accessible summary, model and threshold discussion do not give the equality-threshold logarithmic function T_B, the complete (B,C) root census or exact one/two/three-power decay amplitudes. Prior continuous-time higher-order contagion bistability and polynomial discrete SIS maps prove related qualitative phenomena for different equations. The published SCOPE semantic search returned other SIS critical laws but not an equivalent exponential-overlap fixed-point diagram. This is a best-of-knowledge PASS, not an inaccessible-paper declaration of novelty; the full motivating manuscript could not be inspected, and overlapping unindexed models remain risk.

value.rationale: The equality of pairwise linear threshold is a natural unresolved boundary for higher-order epidemic mean-field dynamics. The result supplies a complete nonnegative-parameter saddle-node/bistability classification, strict homogeneous extinction where appropriate, and sharp distinct s^{-1},s^{-1/2},s^{-1/3} decay with explicit amplitudes and a graph overlap criterion for the last. This quantifies a real model-driven critical transition rather than merely a generic bifurcation slogan or arbitrary numerical slice.
residual_risks: Does not establish exact epidemic survival probabilities or spatially heterogeneous stability.
